findings.highlight: Shirou, who has fallen into a pit just by getting sidetracked
findings.evidenceJa: このままじゃ現世復帰が無理めな士郎
findings.governingReading: Shirou, for whom returning to the present world looks difficult at this rate
findings.explanation: The English removes the mock-afterlife premise that the rescue corner must restore dead Shirou to this world.

findings.highlight: Get your act together and win.
findings.evidenceJa: 勝って兜の緒を締めよ
findings.governingReading: After winning, tighten the cords of your helmet: remain vigilant even in victory.
findings.explanation: The English reverses the proverb into preparation before winning and erases its warning against relaxing after success.
